sketches.mechanism: method_missing — Ruby calls this method when an object receives a message it doesn't understand, allowing it to respond to anything
sketches.resonance: A person who answers to every name they're called, because they have forgotten their own.
sketches.draft:
class Forgotten
  def method_missing(name, *)
    self
  end
end

sketches.mechanism: late keyword — declares a variable that must be initialized before use, but crashes at runtime if read before assignment
sketches.resonance: A promise that was declared but never fulfilled destroys everything at the moment you depend on it.

sketches.mechanism: Pattern matching on function clauses with no catch-all — when no clause matches, the process crashes (let it crash philosophy)
sketches.resonance: When none of the versions of you that someone remembers match who you actually are, the connection dies.
sketches.draft:
defmodule You do
  def recognize(:child), do: :yes
  def recognize(:student), do: :yes
  def recognize(:stranger), do: :yes
end

You.recognize(:who_i_am_now)
